text:
Maya: Quick sync — backlog + the Fincorp private ask are colliding with infra capacity. Thinking we should add a 'fallthrough' policy for cross-team deps and a Gatekeeper weekly unblock meeting. Also want to rescore top 6 initiatives using RICE constrained by staffing. Thoughts? :eyes:
Jordan: Agree. We need RICE but with a 'capacity' modifier. Example quick scores:
```text
- Enable Dedicated Autoscale: R=7 I=6 C=4 E=3 -> Score 126 (but infra cost huge)
- Fincorp Private: R=9 I=8 C=6 E=4 -> Score 288
- Prefix KV cache: R=6 I=5 C=2 E=5 -> Score 150
```
Sam: From eng-platform: infra only has 1 full-time for 2 sprints. Can't take Fincorp end-to-end unless scope reduces. We can upstream a minimal ship: auth + audit only, leave perf tuning for later.
Leo: +1 to Gatekeeper. Also propose 'fallthrough' policy: if infra doesn't ack within 3 business days, default to a reduced scope flag so product can still ship.
Tess: How about we convert RICE to RICExCapacity where Capacity = estimated weeks of cross-team work; lower capacity increases priority cost. Keeps things numeric.
Jordan: Love RICExCapacity. Can we get initial capacity estimates? @Sam can you add a row per initiative with 'infra_wks'?
Sam: I'll add quick estimates by EOD Friday.
Maya: OK — plan: Sam to estimate, Jordan/Roadmap to apply RICExCapacity, Gatekeeper weekly Friday 11am to clear blockers. Owners for Fincorp: Jordan (PM) + Sam (Eng). Action: postset of reduced-scope checklist. Deadline next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
release-bot: New Gatekeeper meeting created: calendar invite sent to Maya, Jordan, Sam, Leo, Tess.
Leo: One more ask — add a 'canary fallback' requirement for any ship that depends on infra changes so we can rollback traffic to hosted models. Keeps SLA safe.
Maya: Agreed. I'll draft launch criteria doc and share in #product before EOD Monday.
Tess: Thanks — this feels actionable. If anyone objects to Gatekeeper cadence, speak now.
Jordan: No objections. moving to owners + tasks.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after Sam's estimates.
